Clarity.justification: The paper is well-structured with logical sections (Introduction, Related Work, Method, Results, Discussion, Conclusion), clear tables (e.g., Table 1 pass@1 values, Table 3 pylint categories), and figures explaining deltas and coverage. Ideas such as style-function dissociation are articulated coherently. Minor issues include inconsistent figure numbering (Figure 1 vs. Figure 4) and some log discrepancies, but overall easy to follow.

Novelty.justification: Presents the first iso-compute (B=1000 tokens) head-to-head comparison of execution vs. pylint/mypy feedback on HumanEval/MBPP, plus the style-function dissociation decomposition (94.3% C-category flags). Builds on prior work (Chen et al. 2023, Shinn et al. 2023) but adds mechanism analysis and benchmark asymmetry findings. Incremental rather than groundbreaking.

Soundness.justification: Methods use appropriate statistical tests (McNemar's exact/chi-square matching code in mcnemar_*.json), iso-compute control, and coverage analysis (E/W vs. C categories). Results in metrics.json exactly match paper claims (e.g., HE exec 0.6585, pylint 0.5671; MBPP exec 0.7328). Minor flaws: single effective round at B=1000, completion rates >1.0 in logs, and unexecuted Qwen replication, but core findings reliable and consistent with code.

Significance.justification: Addresses key VerifAI workshop theme (LLMs for code generation with formal methods integration). Practical impact on feedback selection for LLM repair (+40.2pp MBPP with execution). Findings on style vs. functional coverage have lasting relevance for benchmarks and tool use, though scoped to one model and single round.

strengths: Rigorous iso-compute comparison with statistical validation and mechanism decomposition
Clear empirical evidence supporting execution feedback superiority and style-function dissociation
weaknesses: Limited to single model (Llama 3.1 8B) and effectively one repair round
Some inconsistencies in logs (e.g., completion rates, per-round trajectories) and unexecuted replications
